title: एकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The next day Yudhishthira returns to Bhishma and asks how kingship arose, and Bhishma tells how, in the Golden Age, men ruled themselves by dharma, and then, as dharma failed, they asked Brahma for a lord. He tells of Manu as the first king and the rise of the state.
summary.kn: ಮರುದಿನ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಭೀಷ್ಮನ ಬಳಿ ಮರಳಿ ರಾಜತ್ವ ಹೇಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತೆಂದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕೃತಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರು ಧರ್ಮದಿಂದ ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಆಳಿಕೊಂಡರು, ಧರ್ಮ ಕುಂದಿದಾಗ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನನ್ನು ಅಧಿಪತಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿದರೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮೊದಲ ರಾಜ ಮನು ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಉದಯವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अगले दिन युधिष्ठिर भीष्म के पास लौटकर पूछते हैं कि राजत्व कैसे उत्पन्न हुआ, और भीष्म बताते हैं कि सत्ययुग में लोग धर्म से स्वयं शासित थे, फिर धर्म क्षीण होने पर उन्होंने ब्रह्मा से स्वामी माँगा। वे प्रथम राजा मनु और राज्य के उदय का वर्णन करते हैं।
summary.te: మరుసటి రోజు యుధిష్ఠిరుడు భీష్ముని వద్దకు తిరిగి రాజత్వం ఎలా పుట్టిందని అడుగుతాడు; కృతయుగంలో ప్రజలు ధర్మంతో తమను తాము పాలించుకున్నారని, ధర్మం క్షీణించగా బ్రహ్మను అధిపతిని కోరారని భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. మొదటి రాజు మనువు, రాజ్య ఆవిర్భావాన్ని వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: மறுநாள் யுதிஷ்டிரர் பீஷ்மரிடம் திரும்பி அரசு எவ்வாறு தோன்றியது என்று கேட்க, கிருத யுகத்தில் மக்கள் தர்மத்தால் தம்மைத் தாமே ஆண்டனர், தர்மம் குறைந்தபோது பிரம்மனிடம் தலைவனைக் கேட்டனர் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். முதல் மன்னன் மனுவையும் அரசின் தோற்றத்தையும் விவரிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: അടുത്ത ദിവസം യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ഭീഷ്മരുടെ അടുത്തെത്തി രാജത്വം എങ്ങനെയുണ്ടായെന്ന് ചോദിക്കുന്നു; സുവർണ്ണയുഗത്തിൽ മനുഷ്യർ ധർമ്മത്താൽ സ്വയം ഭരിച്ചിരുന്നുവെന്നും, ധർമ്മം ക്ഷയിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഒരു നാഥനെ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ട് ബ്രഹ്മാവിനെ സമീപിച്ചുവെന്നും ഭീഷ്മർ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. ആദ്യ രാജാവായ മനുവിനെക്കുറിച്ചും രാഷ്ട്രത്തിന്റെ ഉദയത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.59; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः काल्यं समुत्थाय कृतपौर्वाह्णिकक्रियाः ।
ययुस्ते नगराकारै रथैः पाण्डवयादवाः ॥

meaning.en: Then, rising at dawn and finishing their morning rites, the Pandavas and Yadavas set out in chariots as large as cities.

verses.text:
प्रपद्य च कुरुक्षेत्रं भीष्ममासाद्य चानघम् ।
सुखां च रजनीं पृष्ट्वा गाङ्गेयं रथिनां वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Kurukshetra and coming to blameless Bhishma, they asked after the night's comfort of Ganga's son, best of charioteers.

verses.text:
व्यासादीनभिवाद्यर्षीन्सर्वैस्तैश्चाभिनन्दिताः ।
निषेदुरभितो भीष्मं परिवार्य समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Having greeted Vyasa and the other sages and been welcomed by them all, they sat down around Bhishma on every side.

verses.text:
ततो राजा महातेजा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्भीष्मं प्रतिपूज्याभिवाद्य च ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, the greatly radiant king of dharma, honored and greeted Bhishma and said with joined palms:

verses.text:
य एष राजा राजेति शब्दश्चरति भारत ।
कथमेष समुत्पन्नस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, this word "king, king" that goes about, descendant of Bharata, tell me how it came into being.

verses.text:
तुल्यपाणिशिरोग्रीवस्तुल्यबुद्धीन्द्रियात्मकः ।
तुल्यदुःखसुखात्मा च तुल्यपृष्ठभुजोदरः ॥

meaning.en: He has the same hands, head and neck as others, the same mind, senses and nature, the same pain and pleasure, and the same back, arms and belly,

verses.text:
तुल्यशुक्रास्थिमज्जश्च तुल्यमांसासृगेव च ।
निःश्वासोच्छ्वासतुल्यश्च तुल्यप्राणशरीरवान् ॥

meaning.en: the same semen, bone and marrow, the same flesh and blood, the same breathing in and out, and the same life and body.

verses.text:
समानजन्ममरणः समः सर्वगुणैर्नृणाम् ।
विशिष्टबुद्धीञ्शूरांश्च कथमेकोऽधितिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: Equal in birth and death, equal to other men in every quality, how does one man rule over wise men and heroes?

verses.text:
कथमेको महीं कृत्स्नां वीरशूरार्यसंकुलाम् ।
रक्षत्यपि च लोकोऽस्य प्रसादमभिवाञ्छति ॥

meaning.en: How does one man protect the whole earth, crowded with heroes, brave men and nobles, and how does the world seek his favor?

verses.text:
एकस्य च प्रसादेन कृत्स्नो लोकः प्रसीदति ।
व्याकुलेनाकुलः सर्वो भवतीति विनिश्चयः ॥

meaning.en: By one man's favor the whole world is pleased, and when he is disturbed everyone is disturbed; this is certain.

verses.text:
एतदिच्छाम्यहं सर्वं तत्त्वेन भरतर्षभ ।
श्रोतुं तन्मे यथातत्त्वं प्रब्रूहि वदतां वर ॥

meaning.en: I wish to hear all this truly, bull of the Bharatas; tell me as it really is, best of speakers.

verses.text:
नैतत्कारणमल्पं हि भविष्यति विशां पते ।
यदेकस्मिञ्जगत्सर्वं देववद्याति संनतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, it cannot be a small reason that the whole world bows to one man as to a god.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
नियतस्त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ शृणु सर्वमशेषतः ।
यथा राज्यं समुत्पन्नमादौ कृतयुगेऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Listen with attention, best of men, to all of it, how kingship arose at the beginning, in the Krita age.

verses.text:
नैव राज्यं न राजासीन्न दण्डो न च दाण्डिकः ।
धर्मेणैव प्रजाः सर्वा रक्षन्ति च परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: There was neither kingdom nor king, neither punishment nor one to punish; all people protected one another by dharma alone.

verses.text:
पालयानास्तथान्योन्यं नरा धर्मेण भारत ।
खेदं परममाजग्मुस्ततस्तान्मोह आविशत् ॥

meaning.en: But, descendant of Bharata, while protecting each other by dharma, men came to great weariness, and then confusion seized them.

verses.text:
ते मोहवशमापन्ना मानवा मनुजर्षभ ।
प्रतिपत्तिविमोहाच्च धर्मस्तेषामनीनशत् ॥

meaning.en: Fallen under the sway of confusion, bull among men, they lost their understanding, and through that loss of understanding their dharma perished.

verses.text:
नष्टायां प्रतिपत्तौ तु मोहवश्या नरास्तदा ।
लोभस्य वशमापन्नाः सर्वे भारतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: When understanding was lost, best of the Bharatas, men, in the power of confusion, all fell into the power of greed.

verses.text:
अप्राप्तस्याभिमर्शं तु कुर्वन्तो मनुजास्ततः ।
कामो नामापरस्तत्र समपद्यत वै प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Then, laying hands on what was not theirs, lord, another thing arose among men called desire.

verses.text:
तांस्तु कामवशं प्राप्तान्रागो नाम समस्पृशत् ।
रक्ताश्च नाभ्यजानन्त कार्याकार्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Once they were in the power of desire, passion touched them; and, inflamed, Yudhishthira, they no longer knew what should and should not be done.

verses.text:
अगम्यागमनं चैव वाच्यावाच्यं तथैव च ।
भक्ष्याभक्ष्यं च राजेन्द्र दोषादोषं च नात्यजन् ॥

meaning.en: They did not shrink from approaching the forbidden, from saying the unsayable, from eating the uneatable, king of kings, nor from distinguishing fault from no fault.

verses.text:
विप्लुते नरलोकेऽस्मिंस्ततो ब्रह्म ननाश ह ।
नाशाच्च ब्रह्मणो राजन्धर्मो नाशमथागमत् ॥

meaning.en: When the human world was thus thrown into disorder, the Veda was lost, and with the loss of the Veda, king, dharma too was lost.

verses.text:
नष्टे ब्रह्मणि धर्मे च देवास्त्रासमथागमन् ।
ते त्रस्ता नरशार्दूल ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः ॥

meaning.en: When Veda and dharma were lost, the gods were seized with fear; frightened, tiger among men, they took refuge in Brahma.

verses.text:
प्रपद्य भगवन्तं ते देवा लोकपितामहम् ।
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे दुःखशोकभयार्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: Having approached the blessed grandfather of the worlds, all the gods, tormented by sorrow, grief and fear, spoke to him with joined palms.

verses.text:
भगवन्नरलोकस्थं नष्टं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
लोभमोहादिभिर्भावैस्ततो नो भयमाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Blessed one, the eternal Veda has been lost in the world of men through greed, confusion and other states, and fear has entered us.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मणश्च प्रणाशेन धर्मोऽप्यनशदीश्वर ।
ततः स्म समतां याता मर्त्यैस्त्रिभुवनेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: With the destruction of the Veda, lord, dharma too was lost; and so, lord of the three worlds, we have become equal to mortals.

verses.text:
अधो हि वर्षमस्माकं मर्त्यास्तूर्ध्वप्रवर्षिणः ।
क्रियाव्युपरमात्तेषां ततोऽगच्छाम संशयम् ॥

meaning.en: For our rain falls downward, while mortals make theirs rise upward; through the ceasing of their rites we have fallen into doubt.

verses.text:
अत्र निःश्रेयसं यन्नस्तद्ध्यायस्व पितामह ।
त्वत्प्रभावसमुत्थोऽसौ प्रभावो नो विनश्यति ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, think of what is best for us here; our power, which arose from your power, is perishing.

verses.text:
तानुवाच सुरान्सर्वान्स्वयंभूर्भगवांस्ततः ।
श्रेयोऽहं चिन्तयिष्यामि व्येतु वो भीः सुरर्षभाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Self-existent spoke to all the gods: I shall think of what is best; let your fear leave you, bulls among the gods.

verses.text:
ततोऽध्यायसहस्राणां शतं चक्रे स्वबुद्धिजम् ।
यत्र धर्मस्तथैवार्थः कामश्चैवानुवर्णितः ॥

meaning.en: Then he composed from his own mind a work of a hundred thousand chapters, in which dharma, wealth and desire were described.

verses.text:
त्रिवर्ग इति विख्यातो गण एष स्वयंभुवा ।
चतुर्थो मोक्ष इत्येव पृथगर्थः पृथग्गणः ॥

meaning.en: This group, called the three aims, was set forth by the Self-existent, and the fourth, liberation, is separate, a separate goal and a separate group.

verses.text:
मोक्षस्यापि त्रिवर्गोऽन्यः प्रोक्तः सत्त्वं रजस्तमः ।
स्थानं वृद्धिः क्षयश्चैव त्रिवर्गश्चैव दण्डजः ॥

meaning.en: Another triad was also taught for liberation, sattva, rajas and tamas; position, growth and decay form another triad, and one more arises from punishment.

verses.text:
आत्मा देशश्च कालश्चाप्युपायाः कृत्यमेव च ।
सहायाः कारणं चैव षड्वर्गो नीतिजः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: The self, place, time, means, the task and helpers and cause form the sixfold group said to arise from policy.

verses.text:
त्रयी चान्वीक्षिकी चैव वार्ता च भरतर्षभ ।
दण्डनीतिश्च विपुला विद्यास्तत्र निदर्शिताः ॥

meaning.en: The three Vedas, logic, economics and the science of punishment, bull of the Bharatas, were set out there as the vast branches of knowledge.

verses.text:
अमात्यरक्षाप्रणिधी राजपुत्रस्य रक्षणम् ।
चारश्च विविधोपायः प्रणिधिश्च पृथग्विधः ॥

meaning.en: There too were the protection of ministers and the use of agents, the guarding of the prince, spies of many kinds, and agents of different sorts.

verses.text:
साम चोपप्रदानं च भेदो दण्डश्च पाण्डव ।
उपेक्षा पञ्चमी चात्र कार्त्स्न्येन समुदाहृता ॥

meaning.en: Conciliation, gifts, division and force, Pandava, with neglect as the fifth, were all fully explained there.

verses.text:
मन्त्रश्च वर्णितः कृत्स्नस्तथा भेदार्थ एव च ।
विभ्रंशश्चैव मन्त्रस्य सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योश्च यत्फलम् ॥

meaning.en: Counsel was described in full, and its purposes of splitting, the leaking of counsel, and the fruits of its success and failure.

verses.text:
संधिश्च विविधाभिख्यो हीनो मध्यस्तथोत्तमः ।
भयसत्कारवित्ताख्यः कार्त्स्न्येन परिवर्णितः ॥

meaning.en: Treaties of various names, inferior, middling and best, called by fear, honor and wealth, were described in full.

verses.text:
यात्राकालाश्च चत्वारस्त्रिवर्गस्य च विस्तरः ।
विजयो धर्मयुक्तश्च तथार्थविजयश्च ह ॥

meaning.en: The four seasons for marching and the extent of the triad, victory by dharma and victory for gain were described.

verses.text:
आसुरश्चैव विजयस्तथा कार्त्स्न्येन वर्णितः ।
लक्षणं पञ्चवर्गस्य त्रिविधं चात्र वर्णितम् ॥

meaning.en: Victory in the way of the asuras was also described in full, and the marks of the five groups were told here in threefold form.

verses.text:
प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च दण्डोऽथ परिशब्दितः ।
प्रकाशोऽष्टविधस्तत्र गुह्यस्तु बहुविस्तरः ॥

meaning.en: Punishment was called open and hidden; the open is eightfold, while the secret has many branches.

verses.text:
रथा नागा हयाश्चैव पादाताश्चैव पाण्डव ।
विष्टिर्नावश्चराश्चैव देशिकाः पथि चाष्टकम् ॥

meaning.en: Chariots, elephants, horses and foot-soldiers, Pandava, forced labor, boats, scouts and guides on the road make the eight.

verses.text:
अङ्गान्येतानि कौरव्य प्रकाशानि बलस्य तु ।
जङ्गमाजङ्गमाश्चोक्ताश्चूर्णयोगा विषादयः ॥

meaning.en: These, descendant of Kuru, are the open parts of an army; moving and unmoving poisons and powders and the like are named as secret ones.

verses.text:
स्पर्शे चाभ्यवहार्ये चाप्युपांशुर्विविधः स्मृतः ।
अरिर्मित्रमुदासीन इत्येतेऽप्यनुवर्णिताः ॥

meaning.en: Hidden means of various kinds were recalled for touch and for food and drink; and enemy, friend and neutral were also described.

verses.text:
कृत्स्ना मार्गगुणाश्चैव तथा भूमिगुणाश्च ह ।
आत्मरक्षणमाश्वासः स्पशानां चान्ववेक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: All the merits of roads and of terrains were told, and self-protection, reassurance and watching over the secret agents.

verses.text:
कल्पना विविधाश्चापि नृनागरथवाजिनाम् ।
व्यूहाश्च विविधाभिख्या विचित्रं युद्धकौशलम् ॥

meaning.en: Various arrangements of men, elephants, chariots and horses, formations of many names, and the wonderful skill of war were told.

verses.text:
उत्पाताश्च निपाताश्च सुयुद्धं सुपलायनम् ।
शस्त्राणां पायनज्ञानं तथैव भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Portents and falls, good fighting and good retreat, and the knowledge of giving weapons their drink, bull of the Bharatas, were told.

verses.text:
बलव्यसनमुक्तं च तथैव बलहर्षणम् ।
पीडनास्कन्दकालश्च भयकालश्च पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: The troubles and the cheering of an army were told, and the times for pressing, for attacking and for fear, Pandava.

verses.text:
तथा खातविधानं च योगसंचार एव च ।
चौराटव्यबलैश्चोग्रैः परराष्ट्रस्य पीडनम् ॥

meaning.en: So too the digging of trenches, the use of secret movement, and the harassing of an enemy's land with robbers, forest tribes and fierce troops,

verses.text:
अग्निदैर्गरदैश्चैव प्रतिरूपकचारकैः ।
श्रेणिमुख्योपजापेन वीरुधश्छेदनेन च ॥

meaning.en: with arsonists and poisoners, with spies in disguise, by stirring up guild leaders, cutting down vines,

verses.text:
दूषणेन च नागानामाशङ्काजननेन च ।
आरोधनेन भक्तस्य पथश्चोपार्जनेन च ॥

meaning.en: spoiling elephants, creating alarm, blocking the supply of food and seizing the road.

verses.text:
सप्ताङ्गस्य च राज्यस्य ह्रासवृद्धिसमञ्जसम् ।
दूतसामर्थ्ययोगश्च राष्ट्रस्य च विवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: The rise and fall of the seven-limbed kingdom was well weighed, as were the use of envoys' skill and the growth of the country.

verses.text:
अरिमध्यस्थमित्राणां सम्यक्चोक्तं प्रपञ्चनम् ।
अवमर्दः प्रतीघातस्तथैव च बलीयसाम् ॥

meaning.en: The spreading out of enemies, neutrals and friends was rightly told, as were crushing and counter-striking the stronger.

verses.text:
व्यवहारः सुसूक्ष्मश्च तथा कण्टकशोधनम् ।
शमो व्यायामयोगश्च योगो द्रव्यस्य संचयः ॥

meaning.en: Also subtle legal procedure and the weeding out of thorns, peace, exercise and its discipline, and the gathering of goods.

verses.text:
अभृतानां च भरणं भृतानां चान्ववेक्षणम् ।
अर्थकाले प्रदानं च व्यसनेष्वप्रसङ्गिता ॥

meaning.en: The feeding of those not yet maintained, the watching over those maintained, giving at the time of need, and not clinging in misfortunes were told.

verses.text:
तथा राजगुणाश्चैव सेनापतिगुणाश्च ये ।
कारणस्य च कर्तुश्च गुणदोषास्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: The qualities of kings and of generals, and the merits and faults of the cause and of the doer, were told as well.

verses.text:
दुष्टेङ्गितं च विविधं वृत्तिश्चैवानुजीविनाम् ।
शङ्कितत्वं च सर्वस्य प्रमादस्य च वर्जनम् ॥

meaning.en: The various signs of an evil intent, the livelihood of dependents, suspicion of everyone, and the avoidance of negligence.

verses.text:
अलब्धलिप्सा लब्धस्य तथैव च विवर्धनम् ।
प्रदानं च विवृद्धस्य पात्रेभ्यो विधिवत्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Desire for what has not been gained, and the growth of what has been gained, and the proper giving of the increase to worthy recipients,

verses.text:
विसर्गोऽर्थस्य धर्मार्थमर्थार्थं कामहेतुना ।
चतुर्थो व्यसनाघाते तथैवात्रानुवर्णितः ॥

meaning.en: the spending of wealth for dharma, for wealth, and for desire, and a fourth for times of calamity were also described there.

verses.text:
क्रोधजानि तथोग्राणि कामजानि तथैव च ।
दशोक्तानि कुरुश्रेष्ठ व्यसनान्यत्र चैव ह ॥

meaning.en: Ten vices were told, born of anger and fierce, and born of desire, Best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
मृगयाक्षास्तथा पानं स्त्रियश्च भरतर्षभ ।
कामजान्याहुराचार्याः प्रोक्तानीह स्वयंभुवा ॥

meaning.en: Hunting, dice, drink and women, bull of the Bharatas, the teachers say, are those born of desire, as the Self-existent taught here.

verses.text:
वाक्पारुष्यं तथोग्रत्वं दण्डपारुष्यमेव च ।
आत्मनो निग्रहस्त्यागोऽथार्थदूषणमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Harsh speech, ferocity, harshness in punishment, self-restraint, abandonment and spoiling wealth are the others.

verses.text:
यन्त्राणि विविधान्येव क्रियास्तेषां च वर्णिताः ।
अवमर्दः प्रतीघातः केतनानां च भञ्जनम् ॥

meaning.en: Machines of many kinds and their uses were described, along with crushing, striking back, and breaking of enemy standards,

verses.text:
चैत्यद्रुमाणामामर्दो रोधःकर्मान्तनाशनम् ।
अपस्करोऽथ गमनं तथोपास्या च वर्णिता ॥

meaning.en: trampling sacred trees, blockade, destruction of works, plunder, marching, and siege were described.

verses.text:
पणवानकशङ्खानां भेरीणां च युधां वर ।
उपार्जनं च द्रव्याणां परमर्म च तानि षट् ॥

meaning.en: Of drums, kettledrums, conches and battle-bugles, best of warriors, and the gathering of goods and the vital points of an enemy, these are six.

verses.text:
लब्धस्य च प्रशमनं सतां चैव हि पूजनम् ।
विद्वद्भिरेकीभावश्च प्रातर्होमविधिज्ञता ॥

meaning.en: The calming of what has been gained, the honoring of the good, union with the learned, and knowledge of the morning offering,

verses.text:
मङ्गलालम्भनं चैव शरीरस्य प्रतिक्रिया ।
आहारयोजनं चैव नित्यमास्तिक्यमेव च ॥

meaning.en: the touching of auspicious things, remedies for the body, arrangement of food, and constant faith were told as well.

verses.text:
एकेन च यथोत्थेयं सत्यत्वं मधुरा गिरः ।
उत्सवानां समाजानां क्रियाः केतनजास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: How to rise alone, truthfulness, sweet speech, and the arrangements for festivals, assemblies and banners were described.

verses.text:
प्रत्यक्षा च परोक्षा च सर्वाधिकरणेषु च ।
वृत्तिर्भरतशार्दूल नित्यं चैवान्ववेक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: The king's livelihood, open and hidden, in all departments, bull of the Bharatas, and constant oversight were told.

verses.text:
अदण्ड्यत्वं च विप्राणां युक्त्या दण्डनिपातनम् ।
अनुजीविस्वजातिभ्यो गुणेषु परिरक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: The exemption of brahmins from punishment, the proper imposition of punishment, and the guarding of one's dependents and kin in their qualities,

verses.text:
रक्षणं चैव पौराणां स्वराष्ट्रस्य विवर्धनम् ।
मण्डलस्था च या चिन्ता राजन्द्वादशराजिका ॥

meaning.en: the protection of citizens and growth of one's own country, and the thinking about the circle of twelve kings were told.

verses.text:
द्वासप्ततिमतिश्चैव प्रोक्ता या च स्वयंभुवा ।
देशजातिकुलानां च धर्माः समनुवर्णिताः ॥

meaning.en: The seventy-two-fold reckoning proclaimed by the Self-existent, and the duties of lands, castes and families were set forth.

verses.text:
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च मोक्षश्चात्रानुवर्णितः ।
उपायश्चार्थलिप्सा च विविधा भूरिदक्षिणाः ॥

meaning.en: Dharma, wealth, desire and liberation were described there, along with means and the many kinds of desire for wealth, Open-handed one.

verses.text:
मूलकर्मक्रिया चात्र माया योगश्च वर्णितः ।
दूषणं स्रोतसामत्र वर्णितं च स्थिराम्भसाम् ॥

meaning.en: The practice of root-works, trickery and secret arts were described, along with the poisoning of streams and of still waters.

verses.text:
यैर्यैरुपायैर्लोकश्च न चलेदार्यवर्त्मनः ।
तत्सर्वं राजशार्दूल नीतिशास्त्रेऽनुवर्णितम् ॥

meaning.en: Every means by which the world may be kept from straying from the path of the noble was set out in the science of policy, tiger among kings.

verses.text:
एतत्कृत्वा शुभं शास्त्रं ततः स भगवान्प्रभुः ।
देवानुवाच संहृष्टः सर्वाञ्शक्रपुरोगमान् ॥

meaning.en: Having made this auspicious treatise, the blessed lord then, delighted, spoke to all the gods led by Shakra:

verses.text:
उपकाराय लोकस्य त्रिवर्गस्थापनाय च ।
नवनीतं सरस्वत्या बुद्धिरेषा प्रभाविता ॥

meaning.en: This insight, the butter churned from Sarasvati, has been brought forth for the good of the world and to establish the three aims.

verses.text:
दण्डेन सहिता ह्येषा लोकरक्षणकारिका ।
निग्रहानुग्रहरता लोकाननु चरिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Joined with punishment, it guards the world; delighting in restraint and favor, it will go about among the worlds.

verses.text:
दण्डेन नीयते चेयं दण्डं नयति चाप्युत ।
दण्डनीतिरिति प्रोक्ता त्रीँल्लोकाननुवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: It is led by punishment and leads punishment; called the science of punishment, it follows the three worlds.

verses.text:
षाड्गुण्यगुणसारैषा स्थास्यत्यग्रे महात्मसु ।
महत्त्वात्तस्य दण्डस्य नीतिर्विस्पष्टलक्षणा ॥

meaning.en: This essence of the sixfold policy will stand foremost among great souls; because of the greatness of that punishment, the science has clear marks.

verses.text:
नयचारश्च विपुलो येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
आगमश्च पुराणानां महर्षीणां च संभवः ॥

meaning.en: It contains vast knowledge of the conduct of policy, by which all this is pervaded, and the lore of the Puranas and the births of the great sages.

verses.text:
तीर्थवंशश्च वंशश्च नक्षत्राणां युधिष्ठिर ।
सकलं चातुराश्रम्यं चातुर्होत्रं तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Also the lineage of holy places, of families and of constellations, Yudhishthira, the whole of the four stages of life and the four offices of priests,

verses.text:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं तथैवात्र चातुर्वेद्यं च वर्णितम् ।
इतिहासोपवेदाश्च न्यायः कृत्स्नश्च वर्णितः ॥

meaning.en: the four classes and the four Vedas are described here, as are the Itihasas, the auxiliary Vedas and the whole of logic.

verses.text:
तपो ज्ञानमहिंसा च सत्यासत्ये नयः परः ।
वृद्धोपसेवा दानं च शौचमुत्थानमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Austerity, knowledge, non-violence, truth and untruth, the highest policy, serving elders, giving, purity and effort,

verses.text:
सर्वभूतानुकम्पा च सर्वमत्रोपवर्णितम् ।
भुवि वाचोगतं यच्च तच्च सर्वं समर्पितम् ॥

meaning.en: and compassion for all beings, all is described here; and whatever on earth can be put in words is gathered in it.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्पैतामहे शास्त्रे पाण्डवैतदसंशयम् ।
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाश्च सकला ह्यत्र शब्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: In that treatise of the Grandfather, Pandava, undoubtedly dharma, wealth, desire and liberation are all fully set forth.

verses.text:
ततस्तां भगवान्नीतिं पूर्वं जग्राह शंकरः ।
बहुरूपो विशालाक्षः शिवः स्थाणुरुमापतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Shankara was the first to take up that policy, many-formed, wide-eyed, auspicious Sthanu, lord of Uma.

verses.text:
युगानामायुषो ह्रासं विज्ञाय भगवाञ्शिवः ।
संचिक्षेप ततः शास्त्रं महार्थं ब्रह्मणा कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the decline of the lifespan of the ages, the blessed Shiva condensed the vast treatise made by Brahma.

verses.text:
वैशालाक्षमिति प्रोक्तं तदिन्द्रः प्रत्यपद्यत ।
दशाध्यायसहस्राणि सुब्रह्मण्यो महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: Called the Vaishalaksha, it was taken up by Indra, and the great ascetic Subrahmanya made it ten thousand chapters.

verses.text:
भगवानपि तच्छास्त्रं संचिक्षेप पुरंदरः ।
सहस्रैः पञ्चभिस्तात यदुक्तं बाहुदन्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Blessed Purandara in turn condensed that treatise, dear child, to five thousand chapters, called the Bahudantaka.

verses.text:
अध्यायानां सहस्रैस्तु त्रिभिरेव बृहस्पतिः ।
संचिक्षेपेश्वरो बुद्ध्या बार्हस्पत्यं तदुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Brihaspati, the lord, with his understanding condensed it to three thousand chapters; it is called Barhaspatya.

verses.text:
अध्यायानां सहस्रेण काव्यः संक्षेपमब्रवीत् ।
तच्छास्त्रममितप्रज्ञो योगाचार्यो महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: Kavya, the great ascetic of boundless wisdom and teacher of yoga, made the treatise one thousand chapters.

verses.text:
एवं लोकानुरोधेन शास्त्रमेतन्महर्षिभिः ।
संक्षिप्तमायुर्विज्ञाय मर्त्यानां ह्रासि पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: Thus, Pandava, the great sages condensed this treatise in accordance with the needs of the world, knowing that the life of mortals was shrinking.

verses.text:
अथ देवाः समागम्य विष्णुमूचुः प्रजापतिम् ।
एको योऽर्हति मर्त्येभ्यः श्रैष्ठ्यं तं वै समादिश ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods assembled and said to Vishnu, lord of creatures: Name the one who alone deserves supremacy over mortals.

verses.text:
ततः संचिन्त्य भगवान्देवो नारायणः प्रभुः ।
तैजसं वै विरजसं सोऽसृजन्मानसं सुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, after reflection, the blessed god Narayana, the lord, created from his mind a son full of radiance and free of passion.

verses.text:
विरजास्तु महाभाग विभुत्वं भुवि नैच्छत ।
न्यासायैवाभवद्बुद्धिः प्रणीता तस्य पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: But Viraja, blessed one, did not wish for lordship on earth; his mind turned toward renunciation, Pandava.

verses.text:
कीर्तिमांस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूत्सोऽपि पञ्चातिगोऽभवत् ।
कर्दमस्तस्य च सुतः सोऽप्यतप्यन्महत्तपः ॥

meaning.en: His son was Kirtimat, and he too went beyond the five; Kardama was his son, and he too practised great austerity.

verses.text:
प्रजापतेः कर्दमस्य अनङ्गो नाम वै सुतः ।
प्रजानां रक्षिता साधुर्दण्डनीतिविशारदः ॥

meaning.en: Kardama, lord of creatures, had a son named Ananga, a good guardian of the people and expert in the science of punishment.

verses.text:
अनङ्गपुत्रोऽतिबलो नीतिमानधिगम्य वै ।
अभिपेदे महीराज्यमथेन्द्रियवशोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Ananga's son Atibala, who was learned in policy, took the kingdom of the earth, but then fell under the power of his senses.

verses.text:
मृत्योस्तु दुहिता राजन्सुनीथा नाम मानसी ।
प्रख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु या सा वेनमजीजनत् ॥

meaning.en: Mrityu's mind-born daughter, king, called Sunitha, famed in the three worlds, bore Vena.

verses.text:
तं प्रजासु विधर्माणं रागद्वेषवशानुगम् ।
मन्त्रपूतैः कुशैर्जघ्नुरृषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: The brahmin sages killed him, who strayed from dharma among his subjects and followed passion and hatred, with kusha grass purified by mantras.

verses.text:
ममन्थुर्दक्षिणं चोरुमृषयस्तस्य मन्त्रतः ।
ततोऽस्य विकृतो जज्ञे ह्रस्वाङ्गः पुरुषो भुवि ॥

meaning.en: By mantras the sages churned his right thigh, and from it was born on earth a misshapen man of short limbs.

verses.text:
दग्धस्थाणुप्रतीकाशो रक्ताक्षः कृष्णमूर्धजः ।
निषीदेत्येवमूचुस्तमृषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: Like a burnt tree stump, red-eyed and black-haired, he was told by the brahmin sages, "Sit down."

verses.text:
तस्मान्निषादाः संभूताः क्रूराः शैलवनाश्रयाः ।
ये चान्ये विन्ध्यनिलया म्लेच्छाः शतसहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: From him came the Nishadas, cruel dwellers in hills and forests, and the hundreds of thousands of other barbarians who live in the Vindhyas.

verses.text:
भूयोऽस्य दक्षिणं पाणिं ममन्थुस्ते महर्षयः ।
ततः पुरुष उत्पन्नो रूपेणेन्द्र इवापरः ॥

meaning.en: Again those great sages churned his right hand, and from it a man was born as handsome as a second Indra.

verses.text:
कवची बद्धनिस्त्रिंशः सशरः सशरासनः ।
वेदवेदाङ्गविच्चैव धनुर्वेदे च पारगः ॥

meaning.en: Armored, with a sword girded on, with arrows and bow, learned in the Veda and its limbs and a master of the science of the bow,

verses.text:
तं दण्डनीतिः सकला श्रिता राजन्नरोत्तमम् ।
ततः स प्राञ्जलिर्वैन्यो महर्षींस्तानुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: the whole science of punishment attached itself to that best of men, king; and then that son of Vena, with joined palms, spoke to the great sages.

verses.text:
सुसूक्ष्मा मे समुत्पन्ना बुद्धिर्धर्मार्थदर्शिनी ।
अनया किं मया कार्यं तन्मे तत्त्वेन शंसत ॥

meaning.en: A very fine understanding has risen in me that sees dharma and purpose; tell me truly what I should do with it.

verses.text:
यन्मां भवन्तो वक्ष्यन्ति कार्यमर्थसमन्वितम् ।
तदहं वै करिष्यामि नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: Whatever you tell me is to be done, joined with right purpose, that I shall do; no doubt need be had on this.

verses.text:
तमूचुरथ देवास्ते ते चैव परमर्षयः ।
नियतो यत्र धर्मो वै तमशङ्कः समाचर ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods and the great sages said to him: Practise without fear that dharma which is firmly settled.

verses.text:
प्रियाप्रिये परित्यज्य समः सर्वेषु जन्तुषु ।
कामक्रोधौ च लोभं च मानं चोत्सृज्य दूरतः ॥

meaning.en: Giving up likes and dislikes, equal to all creatures, casting far off desire, anger, greed and pride,

verses.text:
यश्च धर्मात्प्रविचलेल्लोके कश्चन मानवः ।
निग्राह्यस्ते स बाहुभ्यां शश्वद्धर्ममवेक्षतः ॥

meaning.en: whatever man in the world strays from dharma must be restrained by you with your arms, always looking to dharma.

verses.text:
प्रतिज्ञां चाधिरोहस्व मनसा कर्मणा गिरा ।
पालयिष्याम्यहं भौमं ब्रह्म इत्येव चासकृत् ॥

meaning.en: Take a vow in mind, deed and word: "I shall always protect the Veda on earth."

verses.text:
यश्चात्र धर्मनीत्युक्तो दण्डनीतिव्यपाश्रयः ।
तमशङ्कः करिष्यामि स्ववशो न कदाचन ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever is said in dharma and policy and depends on the science of punishment, I shall carry out without fear, never following my own will."

verses.text:
अदण्ड्या मे द्विजाश्चेति प्रतिजानीष्व चाभिभो ।
लोकं च संकरात्कृत्स्नात्त्रातास्मीति परंतप ॥

meaning.en: Promise also, lord, "Brahmins are exempt from my punishment, and I shall save the whole world from confusion of classes," tormentor of foes.

verses.text:
वैन्यस्ततस्तानुवाच देवानृषिपुरोगमान् ।
ब्राह्मणा मे सहायाश्चेदेवमस्तु सुरर्षभाः ॥

meaning.en: Then Vena's son said to the gods and the sages who led them: If brahmins are my helpers, so be it, bulls among the gods.

verses.text:
एवमस्त्विति वैन्यस्तु तैरुक्तो ब्रह्मवादिभिः ।
पुरोधाश्चाभवत्तस्य शुक्रो ब्रह्ममयो निधिः ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," Vena's son was told by those speakers of Brahman, and Shukra, a treasury of Brahman, became his priest.

verses.text:
मन्त्रिणो वालखिल्यास्तु सारस्वत्यो गणो ह्यभूत् ।
महर्षिर्भगवान्गर्गस्तस्य सांवत्सरोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The Valakhilyas became his counselors, the Sarasvata group his companions, and the blessed great sage Garga became his astrologer.

verses.text:
आत्मनाष्टम इत्येव श्रुतिरेषा परा नृषु ।
उत्पन्नौ बन्दिनौ चास्य तत्पूर्वौ सूतमागधौ ॥

meaning.en: This is the highest tradition among men: the king and seven others. Two bards were also born for him, Suta and Magadha, who were born before him.

verses.text:
समतां वसुधायाश्च स सम्यगुपपादयत् ।
वैषम्यं हि परं भूमेरासीदिति ह नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: He set right the unevenness of the earth; we have heard that the earth was extremely uneven.

verses.text:
स विष्णुना च देवेन शक्रेण विबुधैः सह ।
ऋषिभिश्च प्रजापाल्ये ब्रह्मणा चाभिषेचितः ॥

meaning.en: He was consecrated for the protection of the people by Vishnu, by Shakra with the gods, by the sages and by Brahma.

verses.text:
तं साक्षात्पृथिवी भेजे रत्नान्यादाय पाण्डव ।
सागरः सरितां भर्ता हिमवांश्चाचलोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: The earth herself came to him bearing her jewels, Pandava, as did the ocean, lord of rivers, and the Himalaya, best of mountains.

verses.text:
शक्रश्च धनमक्षय्यं प्रादात्तस्य युधिष्ठिर ।
रुक्मं चापि महामेरुः स्वयं कनकपर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Shakra gave him inexhaustible wealth, Yudhishthira, and great Meru, the golden mountain, gave him gold itself.

verses.text:
यक्षराक्षसभर्ता च भगवान्नरवाहनः ।
धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च समर्थं प्रददौ धनम् ॥

meaning.en: The blessed Kubera, who is carried by men and is lord of yakshas and rakshasas, gave him wealth sufficient for dharma, wealth and desire.

verses.text:
हया रथाश्च नागाश्च कोटिशः पुरुषास्तथा ।
प्रादुर्बभूवुर्वैन्यस्य चिन्तनादेव पाण्डव ।
न जरा न च दुर्भिक्षं नाधयो व्याधयस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Horses, chariots, elephants and men in crores appeared for Vena's son by his mere thought, Pandava; and there was no old age, no famine, no mental or bodily illness.

verses.text:
सरीसृपेभ्यः स्तेनेभ्यो न चान्योन्यात्कदाचन ।
भयमुत्पद्यते तत्र तस्य राज्ञोऽभिरक्षणात् ॥

meaning.en: Because of that king's protection, there arose there no fear from reptiles, thieves, or from one another at any time.

verses.text:
तेनेयं पृथिवी दुग्धा सस्यानि दश सप्त च ।
यक्षराक्षसनागैश्चापीप्सितं यस्य यस्य यत् ॥

meaning.en: By him this earth was milked of seventeen kinds of grain, and whatever was wished for by yakshas, rakshasas and nagas.

verses.text:
तेन धर्मोत्तरश्चायं कृतो लोको महात्मना ।
रञ्जिताश्च प्रजाः सर्वास्तेन राजेति शब्द्यते ॥

meaning.en: By that great soul this world was made foremost in dharma; all the people were pleased by him, so he was called "king."

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणानां क्षतत्राणात्ततः क्षत्रिय उच्यते ।
प्रथिता धनतश्चेयं पृथिवी साधुभिः स्मृता ॥

meaning.en: Because he saved the brahmins from injury he is called kshatriya, and this earth was made famous through his wealth and is remembered by the good.

verses.text:
स्थापनं चाकरोद्विष्णुः स्वयमेव सनातनः ।
नातिवर्तिष्यते कश्चिद्राजंस्त्वामिति पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: Vishnu himself, the eternal, made the settlement: "No one will go against you, king."

verses.text:
तपसा भगवान्विष्णुराविवेश च भूमिपम् ।
देववन्नरदेवानां नमते यज्जगन्नृप ॥

meaning.en: By his austerity the blessed Vishnu entered the king, so that the world bows to a ruler of men as to a god.

verses.text:
दण्डनीत्या च सततं रक्षितं तं नरेश्वर ।
नाधर्षयत्ततः कश्चिच्चारनित्याच्च दर्शनात् ॥

meaning.en: Protected always by the science of punishment, king, no one assailed him, since he saw the work of spies every day.

verses.text:
आत्मना करणैश्चैव समस्येह महीक्षितः ।
को हेतुर्यद्वशे तिष्ठेल्लोको दैवादृते गुणात् ॥

meaning.en: For the king, by himself and by his instruments, what reason could there be for the world to stay under his control, other than fate and merit?

verses.text:
विष्णोर्ललाटात्कमलं सौवर्णमभवत्तदा ।
श्रीः संभूता यतो देवी पत्नी धर्मस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: Then from Vishnu's forehead a golden lotus arose, from which came the goddess Shri, wife of wise Dharma.

verses.text:
श्रियः सकाशादर्थश्च जातो धर्मेण पाण्डव ।
अथ धर्मस्तथैवार्थः श्रीश्च राज्ये प्रतिष्ठिता ॥

meaning.en: From Shri and Dharma, Pandava, wealth was born; and so dharma, wealth and Shri are established in kingship.

verses.text:
सुकृतस्य क्षयाच्चैव स्वर्लोकादेत्य मेदिनीम् ।
पार्थिवो जायते तात दण्डनीतिवशानुगः ॥

meaning.en: When the merit of a good deed is spent, a man comes from heaven to earth and is born a king, following the power of the science of punishment.

verses.text:
महत्त्वेन च संयुक्तो वैष्णवेन नरो भुवि ।
बुद्ध्या भवति संयुक्तो माहात्म्यं चाधिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: He is joined to greatness of Vishnu's kind, and the man on earth is joined with intelligence and attains majesty.

verses.text:
स्थापनामथ देवानां न कश्चिदतिवर्तते ।
तिष्ठत्येकस्य च वशे तं चेदनुविधीयते ॥

meaning.en: No one goes against the establishment made by the gods; he stays under the control of one if that one is followed.

verses.text:
शुभं हि कर्म राजेन्द्र शुभत्वायोपकल्पते ।
तुल्यस्यैकस्य यस्यायं लोको वचसि तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: A good deed, king of kings, brings about goodness; the world rests on the word of that one man who is of equal body.

verses.text:
यो ह्यस्य मुखमद्राक्षीत्सोम्य सोऽस्य वशानुगः ।
सुभगं चार्थवन्तं च रूपवन्तं च पश्यति ॥

meaning.en: Whoever has seen his face, gentle one, falls under his control, and sees himself fortunate, wealthy and handsome.

verses.text:
ततो जगति राजेन्द्र सततं शब्दितं बुधैः ।
देवाश्च नरदेवाश्च तुल्या इति विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Hence, king of kings, in the world the wise have always said: "Gods and gods among men are alike," lord of the people.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं महत्त्वं प्रति राजसु ।
कार्त्स्न्येन भरतश्रेष्ठ किमन्यदिह वर्तताम् ॥

meaning.en: All this about the greatness of kings has been told to you in full, best of the Bharatas; what else shall we discuss here?
